content.title: Browse and refine a product category
content.description: A shopper opens a top-level category listing, confirms that products are actually presented, changes the sort order among the supported options, adjusts how many products are shown per page, and switches between grid and list presentation without losing the current product set on screen.
content.summary: Browse a category and change result presentation.
content.value: Supports exploratory shopping by letting shoppers navigate categories and control how listings are displayed.
criteria: A top-level category opens a listing page with a product count or product grid.
The listing offers sort options for price low-high, name A-Z, and rating, and the first product changes when the sort order changes.
The listing offers a "show N per page" control, and choosing a larger value increases the number of rendered tiles.
Switching between grid and list view keeps the same products on screen.
